coaching.headline: We gave up Mini Prime, four towers and Fangtooth in the mid-game, then a 4-0 teamfight at 33.4 broke their base.
coaching.team: The duo lane favored us: zero deaths before minute ten for Murdock and Steel against TwinBlast and Phase's one, and we took the game's first Fangtooth. Midlane read 'theirs early, even late': Morigesh caught Lt. Belica alone three times before minute fourteen. An early 8.4 skirmish, flagged as a bad trade, went 0-2. The call to fight at 15.3 cost Mini Prime, and a solo catch on Aurora at 19.4 cost the Outer Tower. Losing the Fangtooth fight at 20.6 cost their Fangtooth outright; Genesis Core and Orb Prime fell in the next three minutes too, both uncontested with nobody of ours dead -- a separate failure to show, not fallout from the fight. From 25 on we won every fight that mattered. We took another Fangtooth at 27.1 and Orb Prime at 32. A 4-0 teamfight at 33.4 broke their Inhibitor, Outer Tower, and Core inside ninety seconds, with the Primal Fangtooth close behind. We cashed all four fights we won within ninety seconds; they closed just two of three. Towers finished 6 to 5 ours.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 4-0 teamfight at 33.4, built mostly by Murdock and Lt. Belica, broke straight into their base — their Inhibitor, Outer Tower, and Core fell in the next ninety seconds, with the Primal Fangtooth landing right behind it.
coaching.whatWorked: We converted every fight we won into a prize within ninety seconds, four for four, while they only closed out two of their three.

synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
enemyKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
enemyKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
enemyKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
enemyKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
enemyKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
enemyKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
enemyKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
enemyKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

enemyKits.combo: Mark a target → Hive slow → Swarm reposition → Curse execute-burst ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Mark + Curse a squishy and delete them with %max-HP Pestilence
enemyKits.playWith: setup that holds her marked target
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's squishy with one escape (Swarm) — dive after it's used; spread vs Hive
